description:
SitusAMC is where the best and most passionate people come to transform our client’s businesses and their own careers. Whether you’re a real estate veteran, a passionate technologist, or looking to get your start, join us as we work together to realize opportunities for everyone, we proudly serve.
 
 At SitusAMC, we are looking to match your unique experience with one of our amazing careers, so that we can help you realize your potential and career growth within the Real Estate Industry. If you are someone who can be yourself, advocate for others, stay nimble, dream big, own every outcome, and think global but act local – come join our team!
We are seeking a Senior Azure DevOps Administrator to own administration, governance, security, integrations, and continuous improvement of our Microsoft Azure DevOps environment. This role will serve as the primary platform administrator and subject matter expert across Azure Repos, Pipelines, Boards, permissions, service connections, and enterprise integrations.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on Azure DevOps administration experience, strong platform governance discipline, and a practical understanding of CI/CD, Git workflows, Agile delivery, security controls, reporting, and user support.

This highly visible role partners with engineering, DevOps, Agile delivery, security, infrastructure, architecture, compliance, and business stakeholders. The role also leads the Azure DevOps governance committee and helps mature platform standards, controls, and operating practices. 
 
 Essential Functions 

 Develop and maintain the in-house CI/CD automation pipeline as an individual contributor on the Cloud development platform team.
 Serve as a CI/CD automation expert, developing tactical release automation plans for products at varying maturity levels.
 Deploy infrastructure across environments using Terraform integrated with Azure DevOps.
 Design and develop scalable stateful and stateless AWS applications using modern tools, cloud architecture, and software design patterns.
 Establish cloud infrastructure standards, templates, and processes; collaborate with internal and external partners on architecture decisions.
 Build and operate secure, scalable AWS platforms across compute, networking, storage, and identity services.
 Enable developer self-service through reusable Terraform modules, standardized AWS environments, and automated provisioning workflows.
 Improve AWS platform reliability through observability, incident troubleshooting, high availability, and automated recovery.
 Administer Azure DevOps projects, repositories, pipelines, permissions, and configurations; standardize naming and remove unused assets.
 Monitor platform health, usage, consumption, and administrative activity to improve governance, costs, risk management, and user experience.
 Govern CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, branch policies, pull requests, and build validation; maintain reusable templates and guardrails with engineering, cloud, DevOps, and security teams.
 Troubleshoot build and release issues, permissions, agent pools, variable groups, environments, approvals, service principals, and dependencies.
 Partner with security teams on DevSecOps, security-as-code, and secure pipeline controls; support audits, access reviews, and privileged access and credential governance.
 Maintain Wiz and Azure DevOps integrations with cloud, identity, reporting, ITSM, notification, and development tools; troubleshoot service connections, webhooks, extensions, APIs, and automation scripts.
 Configure Azure Boards, team processes, backlogs, iterations, work items, queries, dashboards, and delivery plans for Agile, Scrum, and Kanban teams; partner with delivery leaders to improve planning, tracking, backlog hygiene, and cross-team visibility.
 Other activities as may be assigned by your manager
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
 Minimum of 6+ years of industry and/or relevant experience, typically with 1+ years in a Senior Associate level role or external equivalent
 Experience working on automation and developmental works related to infrastructure operations
 Experience in working and implementing Kubernetes and Service mesh technologies such as Istio, LinkerD for communication between services
 Experience in implementing Karpenter for Scaling of API’s in the Cloud
 Proficient in various AWS cloud components for designing and building stateful and stateless applications
 Terraform expertise building IaaC
 Extensive hands-on experience administering Microsoft Azure DevOps in an enterprise environment.
 Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps organizations, projects, repositories, pipelines, boards, artifacts, service connections, permissions, process templates, extensions, and integrations.
 Deep understanding of Git workflows, branching strategies, pull requests, branch policies, repository governance, and code review practices.
 Experience governing Azure Pipelines for CI/CD, including YAML pipelines, build and release workflows, variable groups, environments, approvals, agent pools, and service connections.
 Experience configuring Azure Boards for Agile, Scrum, and Kanban delivery, including backlogs, sprints, area and iteration paths, queries, dashboards, and delivery tracking.
 Strong understanding of DevOps security practices, including least privilege, secrets management, secure service connections, auditability, privileged access, and policy enforcement.
 Experience integrating security tooling into DevOps workflows; Wiz experience is strongly preferred.
 Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across permissions, pipelines, repositories, integrations, boards, identity, and platform configuration.
 Strong communication skills with the ability to guide users, explain technical issues clearly, and advise teams on best practices.
 Experience partnering with engineering, Agile delivery, security, infrastructure, compliance, architecture, and business stakeholders.
 Ability to lead governance forums, facilitate decisions, document standards, and drive action items to completion.
 Strong documentation discipline, including standards, procedures, runbooks, and user-facing guidance.
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Microsoft Azure or Azure DevOps certifications.
 Experience with Azure, Entra ID, identity and access management, service principals, managed identities, and enterprise authentication models.
 Experience with Infrastructure as Code, policy-as-code, security-as-code, and DevSecOps operating models.
 Experience with Wiz, Git, ServiceNow, and related enterprise tooling.
 Experience building Azure DevOps reports or dashboards using Analytics Views, OData, REST APIs, Power BI, or custom automation.
 Experience with Azure DevOps REST APIs, PowerShell, Azure CLI, or scripting for automation and platform administration.
 Experience in regulated, security-conscious, or audit-driven environments.
 Experience defining enterprise DevOps standards for naming conventions, project lifecycle, repository hygiene, pipeline controls, and access governance.
 
 #LI-AS1 #LI-REMOTE
 
 
 Note: This job description is not intended to be all inclusive or exclusive. At any time, employees may perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the organization and participate in additional trainings. SitusAMC does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms or any third parties. Any unsolicited resume submitted to SitusAMC in any manner will be considered SitusAMC property, and SitusAMC will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume.
 
 
 The annual full time base salary range for this role is
$135,000.00 - $165,000.00 
 
 Specific compensation is determined through interviews and a review of relevant education, experience, training, skills, geographic location and alignment with market data. Additionally, certain positions may be eligible to receive a discretionary bonus as determined by bonus program guidelines, position eligibility and SitusAMC Senior Management approval. SitusAMC offers PTO and paid holidays, the terms of which are set forth in the program policies. All full time employees also are eligible to participate in various benefit plans, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance and 401K; in each case in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.
 Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision 
 
 SitusAMC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
